summary: Almaden Minerals Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release updating international arbitration proceedings against Mexico under the CPTPP regarding the Ixtaca project. The release describes the filing of a Reply to Mexico's Counter-Memorial and an increased damages claim of US$2.68 billion. There are no corporate transaction terms, board recommendations, or deal mechanics. The filing is a routine report on litigation progress, not a special situation.
